youtube_meta.title: Someone Has Always Been Knitting | Surreal AI Film (4K)
youtube_meta.description:
Before cities. Before writing. Before anyone thought to write anything down at all - there were hands, and thread, and the slow click of needles in the dark.
This is a film about the oldest thing people still do.
Not a craft. Not a hobby. A language passed from hand to hand across ten centuries, across wars and winters and long waitings - without a single page, without a single word.
Somewhere right now, in a quiet room, someone is making the same motion that has always been made. They don't think about it. That's the whole point.

🎵 Music in This Film
00:00 - Someone Has Always Been Knitting  

All lyrics and original songs written by me. AI was the instrument.
If something made you slow down for a moment - that was the idea.

#surrealaifilm #aifilm #aianimation #knitting #handcrafted #originalmusic

top_comments.author: @jimhallandcindymorgan3545
top_comments.text: I (Cindy) have been knitting for almost 60 years.  When I was 10, I wanted to learn to knit.  The only adult in my family who knew how to knit was my uncle, who then  taught me.  He had learned when he was in the Navy in WWII, because he said that was the only way to have warm socks.  His teaching has given me a lifetime of pleasure, as well as many hours of a calming, meditative process.  It's resulted in many gifts for other people, as well as an on-going gift to me.  Thanks, Uncle Lynton!

top_comments.author: @oceansoul3694
top_comments.text: My grandmother taught me to knit at 5 years old, and now I'm old and knitting every day. This made tears flow, for the beauty you've created and the love therein. I grieve the fact that none of the younger women want to learn. My hands still work, and love flows through them, and you've captured the magic of it. Thank you so much for making the world better!

top_comments.author: @Daliliest-jf8ye
top_comments.text:
Thank u so much for this one... brought me to tears. My GranGranny knitted socks for the whole family as long as she lived... no one ever followed her.. Years later I tried to knit my first pair of socks, following her written instructions... it took me a long time as a young woman with nobody beside, to show me each step. 
Today its me, knitting socks for the whole family, to keep them warm and cosy. I am now 60 years old and i am knitting every Day... it keeps my Mind set and my Head up during these crazy Years of live....
